summary: Iter 134/135 — Logistics Phase 3 (Manpower Mobilization) and Phase 4 (Fuel/Expense/Maintenance/VendorBill/Cost) full end-to-end verification. Wrote 2 new pytest suites (28 tests, all passing) covering CRUD, business rules (approved-mob-only travel, project_code on confirmed, close-checkout validation, demob clearance gates, duplicate detection, sequence prefixes, auto status transitions, cost allocation emission, high-value flag, accounts events). Frontend UI: all 10 new pages render with correct data-testid, sidebar exposes all 10 new nav-* menu items, mobilization CRUD works end-to-end (created rows visible), cost-summary shows all 3 KPIs + Top Projects + By Category. All Phase 1/2 logistics regressions + safety management-review OK.

issues: shadcn <Label> elements are not linked to inputs via htmlFor/id, so get_by_label/label-click accessibility patterns don't work. Cosmetic/a11y only — form fills fine via other selectors.

action_items: (Nit / a11y) Add htmlFor+id linkage on <Label>/Input pairs in LogisticsPhase34Pages.jsx ListPage form for better accessibility.

(Nit) Duplicate testid nav-mobilization used for both HR Deployments (line 154 menuConfig) and Logistics Mobilization (line 347). Not causing failures because they render in different modules, but consider disambiguating (e.g. nav-hr-mobilization vs nav-log-mobilization).
critical_code_review_comments: logistics_phase4_router.py declares `router = APIRouter(...)` twice (line 23 and line 93) — harmless because it's the same prefix/tags, but the second one is redundant and can be removed.

Fuel duplicate check silently skipped when either bill_no or fuel_station is missing — request spec says duplicate vendor+bill_no+date; actual code uses (bill_no + fuel_station + entry_date). Aligned with router semantics but slightly different vocabulary from the spec.
_emit_cost early-returns None when amount==0 — cost approvals for zero-amount items produce no cost allocation (probably intended).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 10 pages render, all 10 nav items present, CRUD works, regressions OK)
